explanations: The timestamp and signature are computed once, before the retry loop, so a retry sent minutes later still carries the original timestamp. Subscribers enforce a replay window (5 minutes here), so the second and later attempts are rejected as stale; the 15-minute backoff guarantees it. The signature covers the timestamp, so the fix computes both inside the loop for each attempt, while keeping the body and the webhook-id identical so subscribers can still deduplicate.
